declaration.preface: OGNIBENE INDIA PVT LTD, incorporated on February 10, 2006, is dedicated to designing and manufacturing hydraulic cylinders and hydraulic steering systems for off-highway vehicles, automotive, and marine applications. We are committed to upholding the highest standards of labor rights and human rights. We believe that every employee deserves a safe, equitable, and inclusive work environment. Our policy outlines our commitments to address critical areas of labor rights and human rights within our operations.
declaration.declaration: OGNIBENE INDIA PVT LTD is dedicated to fostering a workplace that respects labor rights and human rights. We are committed to providing a safe and healthy work environment, ensuring fair working conditions, promoting structured social dialogue, and supporting diversity, equity, and inclusion. We actively prevent child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking in our operations and supply chain.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all workers, employees, directors, officers, agents, contractors, and any third parties acting on behalf of OGNIBENE INDIA PVT LTD. It covers all business activities, including procurement, sales, marketing, and any interactions with government officials, customers, suppliers, and other stakeholders. The policy is applicable globally, regardless of local business practices or cultural norms. This policy applies to below mentioned locations:

focusAreas: Child Labor, Forced Labor & Human Trafficking

Employee Health & Safety: Commitment: To ensure safety at work through comprehensive health and safety programs, aiming to maintain workplace accidents by 0% by 2030 and maintain a 95% employee satisfaction rate regarding health and safety measures. By implementing advanced safety training, hazard monitoring systems, and regular emergency drills, we target zero fatal incidents and achieve 100% compliance with safety standards by 2030.
Working Conditions: Commitment: To promote work-life balance and fair working conditions, targeting an 88% satisfaction rate in employee surveys by 2030. By implementing flexible scheduling, improved workplace ergonomics, and enhanced rest and welfare facilities, we achieve a 30% improvement in employee retention and reduce absenteeism by 20% by 2030.
Social Dialogue: Commitment: To facilitate structured social dialogue through recognized employee representatives, ensuring at least 80% of employee concerns are addressed within one year by 2030. By conducting quarterly meetings, publishing feedback summaries, and tracking resolutions, we achieve 100% employee participation in dialogue programs and strengthen trust by 2030.
Career Management & Training: Commitment: To support employees in career development by providing a minimum of 25 hours of training per employee annually and achieving a 30% internal promotion rate for eligible positions by 2030. By introducing leadership development programs and e-learning modules, we improve average employee skill index by 35% and increase training satisfaction by 25% by 2030.
Discrimination & Harassment: Commitment: To maintain a workplace that is free from any form of discrimination, harassment, or retaliation, ensuring every employee is treated with dignity and respect, we aim to achieve zero confirmed cases of discrimination or harassment by 2030. By implementing awareness campaigns and mandatory anti-harassment training, we ensure 100% employees gain knowledge about these issues. We are committed to addressing 100% of reported cases within 30 days and ensuring that all managers complete annual sensitivity training by 2030.
Child Labor, Forced Labor & Human Traffi: Commitment: To strictly prohibit child labor, forced labor, or human trafficking, committing to 100% compliance through annual audits and zero reported incidents by 2030. By establishing supplier monitoring systems and whistleblower protection mechanisms, we ensure 100% vendor compliance and provide annual awareness training to all employees by 2030.
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: Commitment: To create an inclusive workplace free from discrimination, harassment, or abuse, targeting a 20% increase in workforce diversity by 2030 and a 95% employee satisfaction rate regarding inclusion initiatives. By implementing gender equity initiatives, awareness programs, and mentorship opportunities, we achieve 100% pay equity across all levels and zero discrimination complaints by 2030.
Human Rights in Community Engagement: Commitment: To address both direct and indirect human rights impacts of the company’s operations on external stakeholders, committing to 100% compliance with human rights due diligence by 2030, and to ensure zero reported violations of stakeholder human rights through annual assessments.
Living Wage: Commitment: To ensure all employees receive a living wage that meets basic needs, we are targeting to maintain we target 100% compliance by 2030. By reviewing wage structures and linking annual increments to cost-of-living indices, we ensure zero pay gap across all employee categories by 2030
Mental Health Support: Commitment: To promote mental well-being by offering mental health resources and training, aiming for a 70% participation rate in mental health programs among employees by 2030.
Supplier Labor Standards: Commitment: To ensure suppliers adhere to labor rights standards by conducting audits on 100% of key suppliers by 2030 to verify compliance.

The implementation and compliance of this Labor & Human Rights Policy are overseen by HR Manager and the Compliance Officer at OGNIBENE INDIA PVT LTD.
Together, they foster a culture of accountability and transparency to uphold labor and human rights within the organization.

policy.reviewMechanism: This Labor & Human Rights Policy will be conducted every two years by the HR Manager and the Compliance Officer to ensure its relevance and effectiveness. They will assess the implementation of the policy, gather feedback from employees, and make necessary updates based on evolving best practices in labor and human rights. The HR Manager will lead the review process, while the Compliance Officer will provide insights on regulatory changes and compliance issues to ensure ongoing alignment with legal requirements.
